Proposed slots (PST):
- Mon 11/29 10:00–10:45
- Tue 11/30 14:00–14:45

1) Introductions & goals (5)
2) Procurement requirements (billing entity, W-9, purchasing thresholds) (10)
3) MAP review: owners, milestones, target dates (10)
4) Contract/PO execution path & redline owners (10)
5) Next steps & success criteria (5)

Please let me know which slot works or propose alternatives, and share any specific items you want on the agenda (e.g., security docs, audit windows).
